en.label: Queen Mary University of London exchange
en.question: Did Diego study abroad?
en.answer: Yes — Diego did an academic exchange at Queen Mary University of London (Sep 2025 – Jan 2026), taking Introduction to AI (grade A) and Multi-Platform Game Development (grade B).

es.answer: Sí — Diego hizo un intercambio académico en Queen Mary University of London (sep. 2025 – ene. 2026), donde cursó Introduction to AI (A) y Multi-Platform Game Development (B).
